$comment: Text pool for the Health Issues prayer category.
requests: Healing for my back. It has been a hard month.
My dad starts a new treatment on Monday. Praying it helps.
For my wife, waiting on test results this week.
Strength for my coworker who is recovering from knee surgery.
Pray for my migraines to ease up. Thank you all.
Asking for healing for my grandson's asthma.
Good news from the biopsy, please. We are trusting God.
My neighbor is home after surgery and needs rest and healing.
Peace for me as I wait on a new diagnosis.
I have a surgery scheduled for the end of the month. I am more nervous than I expected to be. Please pray for peace, for the surgeon's hands, and for a quick recovery so I can get back to my kids.
My mom was diagnosed with diabetes last week. She is overwhelmed by all the changes to her diet and routine. Pray that she learns quickly and feels encouraged instead of scared.
Would you pray for my husband? His blood pressure has been high for months and the medicine is not working yet. The doctors are trying something new.
Our daughter has had stomach pain on and off since summer, and nobody can tell us why. We have another appointment next week. Pray for answers and for her to feel better.
I am 28 weeks pregnant and the doctors are watching some complications closely. I am on modified bed rest. Pray for the baby to keep growing strong and for me to stay calm.
My father is 84 and his memory is slipping. Some days are good and some are hard. Pray for patience for all of us, and for wisdom as we decide on the next steps for his care.
Chronic pain has been my companion for years now. Most days I manage, but this week has been rough. I would love prayer for relief and for the energy to keep showing up for my family.
A friend from my small group just learned she has breast cancer. She starts chemo soon. Pray for strength, for her kids, and for the treatment to work.
Lifting up my brother back in Ohio. He had a heart scare last week and is waiting on more tests. He is not a believer yet, and I am praying this opens a door.
I tore my rotator cuff and need surgery. I work with my hands, so the time off is scary. Pray for healing and for our budget while I recover.
Asking for prayer for my coworker's little boy. He has seizures and they are trying a new medication. The family is worn out.
My hearing has been getting worse and I have an appointment with a specialist. It sounds small, but it scares me. Pray that I can hear my grandkids clearly again.
Thank you for praying for my mom's knee replacement last spring. Now her other knee needs the same thing. Pray for a smooth surgery and a faster recovery this time.
My son was just diagnosed with type 1 diabetes. He is nine. We are learning so much so fast. Pray for him to adjust well and for us to have wisdom and calm.
I have been dealing with fatigue that will not go away. The bloodwork came back mostly normal, so we are still looking. Pray for answers and for strength in the meantime.
Our pastor's wife asked me to share this. Her sister is fighting an infection that is not responding to antibiotics. Pray for the right treatment to be found quickly.
For my aunt, who has Parkinson's. The tremors are getting harder for her. Pray for comfort, good care, and that she still finds joy in each day.
My wife's MRI showed something the doctors want to look at more closely. We do not know anything yet. Pray for good news and for peace while we wait.
I am finally getting my hip replaced after putting it off for two years. Pray that everything goes smoothly and that I can walk without pain again.
Healing for my neighbor across the street. She has lupus and has been in a flare for weeks. Her husband is doing his best to keep things going at home.
Grateful for good doctors, but my dad's kidney numbers are not where they should be. Pray that the new plan works and that he does not need dialysis.
Please pray for my best friend from college. She still has lingering symptoms from an illness last year and cannot work full time. She is discouraged.
Our grandson was born with a heart condition and will need a procedure before he turns one. Pray for him to grow strong and for his parents to have peace.
My mother-in-law fell last month and broke her wrist. She is healing slowly and is frustrated about not being able to do things on her own. Pray for patience and strength.
Lift up my sister, please. She is pregnant with twins and has developed high blood pressure. The doctors are monitoring her twice a week.
Asking God for healing in my lungs. I have had a cough for three months, and more tests are scheduled. Pray that I can rest well at night.
One of the guys on my crew at work found out he has cancer. He is only 35. Pray for healing and for his wife and their two young kids.
I am starting physical therapy for my shoulder. It is slow and it hurts. Pray for steady progress and for me to stick with it.
My dad has been stubborn about seeing a doctor, but he finally agreed to go next week. Pray he is honest about his symptoms and that it is nothing serious.
Our family is caring for my grandmother at home now. Her heart is weak and she tires quickly. Pray for her comfort and for all of us who take turns with her care.
Would love prayers for my eyes. I have a condition that is slowly affecting my vision, and I see a specialist in Phoenix next month.
For my coworker who has been out on medical leave. We do not know all the details, but we miss her and want her to heal fully.
Prayer for my teenage daughter, who has been having bad headaches. They are doing scans to rule some things out. She is trying to be brave.
My husband has sleep apnea and just started using a machine at night. It has been a big adjustment. Pray it helps and that he gets real rest.
My friend's dad has cancer and the treatment options are running thin. Pray for comfort, for good days together, and for a miracle if that is God's will.
I just found out I need gallbladder surgery. It is routine, I know, but I have never had surgery before. Pray for calm nerves and a quick recovery.
Our youngest has severe food allergies and had a scary reaction at a birthday party. She is fine now, but we are shaken. Pray for protection and wisdom for us.
My mom is going through cancer treatment and is losing her appetite. Pray she can eat and keep up her strength for the next round.
Healing for my wife after her back surgery. She is home now but still in a lot of pain. Pray that the recovery goes faster than the doctors expect.
My uncle has COPD and is on oxygen now. Summers in Arizona are hard on him. Pray for easier breathing and for him to stay out of the hospital.
A family in our neighborhood has a little girl with leukemia. They are not part of a church, but I told them we would pray. Please join me.
Recovery has been slower than I hoped after my car accident in the spring. My neck and back still hurt most days. Pray for healing and for me to be patient with my body.

I have been putting off asking for prayer, but I think it is time. A few months ago I was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease. Some days I feel almost normal, and other days I cannot get out of bed. My family has been wonderful, but I feel like a burden. Pray for healing, for the medicine to start working, and for me to accept help without feeling guilty about it.

My father is 79 and has been living alone since my mom passed. Last month he had a small stroke. He recovered most of his speech, but he is not as steady on his feet. My brothers and I are trying to decide whether he should move in with one of us or go to assisted living. Pray for his health, for wisdom for us, and for him to feel respected through all of it.

We found out at our 20-week appointment that our baby has a condition that will need surgery soon after birth. The doctors are hopeful, and the specialists are some of the best. Still, it is a lot to carry. Pray for the baby to grow strong, for my body to carry this pregnancy to full term, and for my husband and me to lean on God and each other.

Our son is a sophomore and plays three sports. He tore his ACL in a game two weeks ago and has surgery scheduled for Thursday. The surgery itself is not what worries me most. He is crushed about missing the season and has been pulling away from his friends. Pray for healing in his knee and in his heart, and for him to see that his worth is not in a sport.

Writing this for my wife, who would never ask for herself. She has had migraines for years, but they have become almost daily. She still gets up, takes care of the kids, and goes to work. I see how much it costs her. We are trying a new neurologist next month. Pray for real relief, and for her to know she is loved and not alone in it.

My mom has been sick on and off for most of the year. First it was pneumonia, then a fall, and now her heart doctor wants to change her medicine. She lives back in Ohio, and I cannot be there as much as I want. Pray for her healing, for my sister who is there every day, and for me to trust God with what I cannot control from here.

I am a nurse, and for the first time I am on the other side of things. I have a surgery coming up and a long recovery after it. I know too much about what can go wrong, and my mind keeps going there. Pray that I can rest in God instead of my own knowledge. 'God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.' (Psalm 46:1, WEB)

A coworker of mine has been fighting cancer for three years. She just learned it has come back. She told me she is tired, but she is not giving up. She has two kids in high school and wants to see them graduate. Pray for healing, for strength for the next round of treatment, and for her family as they walk through this again.

My grandmother is 92 and has been the rock of our family for as long as I can remember. Her health is failing, and the doctors say there is not much more they can do. She is at peace and keeps telling us she is ready. Pray for her comfort, and for the rest of us to cherish these days instead of just dreading what comes next.
details: It has been a long few months for our family, and we are tired.
We are trusting God with this, but some days it is hard.
The waiting is the hardest part right now, more than anything else.
Pray for the doctors and nurses too, that they would have wisdom.
We have so many questions, and the answers are coming slowly.
Thank you for carrying this with us. It means more than you know.
Pray for the whole family, who are worried and worn out.
Insurance and appointments have been a lot to sort out, so pray for clear answers there too.
Some days are better than others. Today was a hard one.
We want to trust God's timing, even when it feels slow.
I keep reminding myself that God is not surprised by any of this.
There are more appointments ahead, and the back and forth adds up.
Pray for good sleep. Rest has been hard to come by lately.
Also asking for peace at night, when the worry feels the loudest.
We are grateful for the meals and texts from our small group.
I do not always know what to pray, so I am thankful for those who do.
Asking for healing, but also for peace no matter how this turns out.
Wisdom is needed for every decision about care and treatment.
It is a lot to carry, and we are leaning on our church family.
God has been faithful before, and we believe He will be again.
answers: The doctors are encouraged, and so are we. Thank you for praying.
We got good news this week. God is so good. Thank you, church family.
Things are slowly getting better. Thank you for not giving up on praying.
No clear answers yet, but we have real peace while we wait.
Much better than a month ago. Still a ways to go, but we are thankful.
Praise God! This turned out better than anyone expected.
It has been up and down, but the last few weeks have been steady. Keep praying, please.
We are still waiting on answers. God has given us peace in the middle of it.
Doing well now and back to most of the normal routine. Thank you all for the prayers and meals.
The new plan seems to be working. We are cautiously hopeful.
Answered prayer! Feeling stronger every day.
Not the outcome we hoped for yet, but we feel carried by your prayers.
Thank you for praying. The worst of it is behind us now.
Some improvement this month, and a clearer path forward. That alone is a relief.
We have a plan now, and that has brought a lot of peace. Thank you for walking with us.
Still hard some days, but things are more manageable and the outlook is good.
God answered in ways we did not expect. We are grateful for every one of you.
Everyone involved in the care has been wonderful, and things are moving in the right direction.
Stable for now, which is its own kind of answer. Thank you for praying.
We are at peace, whatever comes next. Your prayers have meant the world.
